name: oracle-firefox
description: Consult ChatGPT in standalone or project conversations and continue existing chats automatically through Firefox using WebDriver BiDi.

interface.shortDescription: Consult ChatGPT through Firefox without Chrome.
interface.longDescription: Oracle Firefox gives Codex a local, Firefox-native second-opinion workflow. It can discover ChatGPT projects and chats, start standalone or project consultations with selected source files, and safely continue one exact existing conversation.
defaultPrompt: Get a Firefox-backed second opinion on this code.
Ask ChatGPT to review these files in a project through Firefox.
Continue an existing ChatGPT conversation through Firefox.
